text:
sophie: Heads-up: customer asks for an on-prem installer of Kerosene-7B. Upstream license tag = "non-commercial; redistribution prohibited". Question: can we ship int8 qweights in an installer, or is that redistribution/derivative? cc @liz-legal

parth: If installer writes extractable weight files to disk = redistribution. Even a sealed image can be considered distribution if they can image it.

liz-legal: Right. Two legal-safe paths: (1) obtain explicit commercial/sublicense for derivatives and redistribution from upstream; (2) provide a custodial/hosted-like appliance where weights are never extractable and we retain custody. On-prem installers where customer controls the files are risky.

aj: Sales note: customer prefers to self-run. Timeline ~3w. If legal requires a sublicense, that could delay. They might accept a sealed image if we guarantee non-extractability and provide attestation.

maria: Eval summary: fp16 baseline ppl 12.0; prepackaged int8 -> ppl 12.7 and +4% hallucination on long summaries. We planned to ship qweights to reduce cold-start but that's blocked if redistribution prohibited.

tim: Tech options: runtime in-RAM quantization (mmap fp16, quantize into private memory, never write qfile). Pros: no persistent qweights. Cons: ~4-8s cold-start penalty and must disable swap/crash dumps or encrypt them. Also add runtime guard to deny any export operation.

license-checker: license snapshot: https://redwood-internal/model-licenses/kerosene-7b.txt (scan: commercial_use=NO, redistribution=PROHIBITED, derivative=UNCLEAR)

parth: If we go sealed image path, add contract clause forbidding extraction + Redwood audit rights. Some licensors still refuse any distribution even with contract.

liz-legal: I'll open LIC-8825 and start upstream outreach asking for explicit derivative + commercial rights. If granted, require clear attribution wording included in product materials.

aj: I'll inform the customer about options: (A) wait for license clearance, (B) accept managed appliance where Redwood controls HSM/keys and attests non-extractability.

maria: For packaging gates: propose MMLU delta <1% rel, long-context halluc delta <2.5% abs, cold-start latency <10s. If any fail, block automatic release.

tim: Implementation items: add REDWOOD_NO_EXPORT env, refuse CLI export, add audit event when quantization runs, ensure swap disabled in installer. Also add a README note forbidding export commands.

sophie: Action list: (1) @liz-legal open LIC-8825 and reach out upstream; (2) @aj notify customer choices; (3) @tim prototype in-RAM quant and guards; (4) @maria add gating checks to onboarding CI; (5) @parth update packaging docs. Will keep this thread as canonical.
